The Termwright-owned POSIX addon keeps the root unreaped at its waitid(WNOWAIT) boundary, kills the still-unreusable process group, and only then reaps it. The Windows addon assigns the suspended root to a kill-on-close Job Object before it can run and queries that job for tree liveness. Native lifecycle tests cover roots exiting before descendants and hard teardown on both operating-system families.

The Termwright-owned addon reads the POSIX master through kernel EOF/EIO and the ConPTY output pipe through its real end. Data and EOF share one bounded ordered native-to-JS channel; TerminalSession drains the VT before publishing exit. Saturated tail-plus-sentinel tests and packed clean-install smokes certify the boundary without a timer, quiet window or dependency-private field.
Windows rejects unsupported POSIX signals; Ctrl+C, terminate and hard kill are separate.
Teardown intent is recorded only after an accepted lifecycle operation.
driver/pty.ts bounds pre-subscriber output at 4 MiB and fails rather than silently drops.

PtyProcess.write explicitly means ordered backend-queue admission, never child consumption; high-level actions require committed postconditions. The native POSIX and ConPTY writers each own an 8 MiB ordered queue, reject overflow synchronously, publish drain only after admitted bytes leave the queue, and enter a permanent fail-closed state after delivery failure. Saturation, drain, post-EOF rejection and teardown-under-pressure tests exercise the real addon rather than a fake adapter.

The original diagnosis that a dependency's public stream could supply the required write/error/drain and EOF contracts was incorrect. Termwright now owns the native input queue, output channel, pseudoterminal and process tree on every supported platform; no node-pty source, private field, patch, fallback or compatibility path remains.
SemanticChannel atomically claims one adapter and rejects simultaneous second hellos.
Every accepted socket is owned and unauthenticated handshakes have an absolute deadline.

Correctness deadlines and TTLs are monotonic. quality/determinism-constructs.json now classifies every timer, polling loop, skip, fixed port, process-global mutation and fire-and-forget site; CI rejects inventory drift, fixed listen ports and browser waitForTimeout. Remaining wall clocks are display/persistence facts and external-source polling is explicit.

Locator/action/attach, shell phases, desktop-host connect/ready, and launch endpoint/log/PTY/required-negotiation phases use one original monotonic deadline. Expiry before spawn proves zero process allocation and every post-allocation expiry rolls back through ResourceScope. Native attempt budgets reserve diagnostics/trace/teardown time.
Matchers/snapshots/log assertions use arm-before-check events, not 25 ms polling.

Semantics policy is explicit and required negotiation consumes the original deadline.
